1.1.0.lead: nexbeat can now request from nexcrate as well, and from this version on this window tells you after each update what changed.

sections.title: Requests to nexcrate
sections.body: Where there was only Lidarr, an administrator can now choose nexcrate. Nothing changes for you: request as usual and follow the state under My requests.
sections.where: Menu at your name › My requests

sections.title: About nexbeat
sections.body: Version, licence and this text now live at the bottom, under “About nexbeat” in the footer. You can open this window again from there.

sections.title: Update hint
sections.body: Once a day nexbeat asks GitHub whether there is a newer version and shows it in the footer and on the page. It can be switched off on the same page.

small: When nexcrate refuses something, its own reason is shown below.
After connecting to nexcrate the library is there at once.

1.1.1.lead: Two repairs: requests to a slow nexcrate, and artists who share a name.

sections.title: Requests to a slow nexcrate
sections.body: When nexcrate took longer than a minute to answer, nexbeat showed error 504 although the request had arrived, and sent it a second time in the background. nexbeat now hands a request over in the background and never sends the same one twice at once. Until nexcrate has taken it, the request says "Handing over".
sections.where: Menu at your name › My requests

sections.title: Artists who share a name
sections.body: Artists of the same name all got the photo and the top tracks of the best known one. Both now come by the artist's MusicBrainz entry, and search tells namesakes apart by country and description.
